outline: Introducing special topics of modern and critical manufacturing technology. Including:1. Simulation and verification platform based on computerized manufacturing systems. 2. gamification-based manufacturing flow control and multi-skilled training. 3. Manufacturing experiments and analytical evaluation.

======    =============

06-07      Applications of CIM: reverse engineering (RE) and
augmented reality (AR) multi-tasks training

10-14      Introduction of manufacturing flow control with
gamification: famous production game
for the real-world technology breakthrough
